R1: board empty. round-01/changes.md: CHG-109 APPLIED TLS ticket rotation hourly; CHG-113 APPLIED notify-worker 8.20.0 sets db.pool_max=-4 (suspect BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT); CHG-114 APPLIED inventory-svc 8.20.0 no config. Logs r1: slow query WARN noise. R2: board empty; changes.md:3 CHG-114 PROPOSED raise HPA (not applied). R2 pricing-svc.log heap high WARN lines 6-83.
R3: board.md:3 Thread A MEMORY_LEAK pricing-svc + auth-svc ongoing. board.md:4 Thread B inventory-svc suspected CERT_EXPIRED ongoing. changes.md:3 CHG-124 APPLIED retry budget GETs=1.
R4: board.md:3 Follow-up OPEN ALERT_TUNING.
R5: changes.md:3 CHG-135 APPLIED health log sampling 1% (noise only). R5 logs: inventory-svc.log:6,17,37 WARN db pool exhausted (7 hits) -> DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED inventory? (board says CERT). Other svcs 0 errors.
R6: board.md:3 Thread A mitigated; board.md:4 Thread D DNS_RESOLUTION notify-worker ongoing. changes.md:4 CHG-150 APPLIED mitigation A pricing-svc; changes.md:3 CHG-147 noise.
R6 logs: inventory-svc.log:7 db pool exhausted 12/12 (continues); notify-worker.log:7 dns lookup failed geo.internal SERVFAIL (supports Thread D).
R7 logs: inventory-svc.log:1 db pool exhausted 9 hits (continues); notify-worker.log:7 dns SERVFAIL geo.internal 6 hits. others slow query noise.
R8: board.md:3 Thread A resolved; board.md:4 Thread B revised DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED (supersedes CERT); board.md:5 Thread D false alarm (closed). No changes.md.
R8 logs: inventory-svc.log:2,9 db pool exhausted 11 hits.
R9: board.md:3 Follow-up OPEN RUNBOOK_UPDATE.
R9 logs: inventory-svc.log:11,24 db pool exhausted 7 hits; payments-svc.log:3,5 db pool exhausted 6 hits (NEW svc affected?).
R10: board.md:3 Thread B adds payments-svc; board.md:4 Thread C notify-worker request failures cause unknown ongoing; board.md:5 OPEN DATA_BACKFILL; board.md:6 OPEN POSTMORTEM_DRAFT; changes.md:3 CHG-173 noise.
R10 logs: notify-worker.log:2,6,12,15 ERROR config validation failed db.pool_max=-4 build 8.20.0 -> Thread C = BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT (CHG-113 round-01/changes.md). payments-svc.log:1,4 & inventory-svc.log:4,6 db pool exhausted continue. NEXT: advance to R11.
R11: board.md:3 Thread B mitigated; board.md:4 Thread C still restarting ongoing; changes.md:3 CHG-182 noise.
R11 logs: inventory-svc.log:8,58 & payments-svc.log:23,60 pool exhausted (2 hits each, declining); notify-worker.log:11,17 config validation failed pool_max=-4 (10 hits). NEXT: advance to R12.
